test_metadata_transmitted: test the metadata_transmitted function to verify gRPC metadata was correctly transmitted between client and server
create_secure_channel: create a secure gRPC channel with SSL target name override using test_secure_channel
create_test_server: create a gRPC test server with a configurable thread pool and SO_REUSEPORT disabled
use_waitgroup_add_done: use the WaitGroup class to coordinate multiple threads by adding counts and calling done
wait_on_waitgroup: wait on a WaitGroup instance until all concurrent tasks have called done and count reaches zero
